answer.book: Marlorat's Thesaurus Sacrae Scripturae Propheticae et Apostolicae (Geneva 1613), a Latin alphabetical dictionary of Scripture terms: a short front matter (dedication, preface, word index), the headword body from A to Z with no numbered divisions, then a closing Elenchus rerum, a subject index and an index of scripture passages.
